# charly tui — the agent control-plane terminal UI

`charly tui` opens the terminal UI for Charly's agent control plane. Served by
`candy/plugin-agent` (`command:tui`).

## What it does

Browses and drives agent sessions, runs, and terminal channels interactively — the
visual counterpart to the `charly agent` command family. It shares the agent
control-plane model: daemon-free sessions, runs, terminal channels, Pi
native/orchestrator/TUI modes, and the tmux compatibility layer.

## When to use it

For interactive inspection/control of agent sessions. For scripting or a single
operation, use `charly agent` instead.
